name: Turkey-Feta Meatballs with Lemony Tahini Sauce, Roasted Carrots & Mint
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle carrots with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until carrots are tender and golden brown, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Divide between a medium and a small bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems. Mince half of the leaves and add to the medium bowl. Roughly chop (or tear) remaining leaves and add to the small bowl; set aside for serving.

Add turkey, feta, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices to the medium bowl; use your hands to combine the turkey mixture. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Remove from heat.
When the carrots are golden, remove from the oven and toss. Add meatballs to the baking sheet, nestling them into the carrots.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until the carrots are deep brown and meatballs are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice one lemon into another small bowl. Cut remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add tahini, water, and spices to the bowl with the lemon juice. Whisk to combine the sauce.
Divide carrots and meatballs between plates; drizzle meatballs with tahini sauce and top veggies with reserved green onion and mint. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
